title: Social Media Algorithms Amplified Disinformation Campaign in Honduras Election

behaviors.text: In October 2021, a coordinated network of over 317 fake Twitter accounts leveraged AI-driven algorithms to amplify disinformation about the Honduran presidential election, targeting opposition candidate [person].
The campaign spread false narratives to suppress voter turnout and undermine the election's [person].
Social media platforms, including Twitter and Facebook, removed the accounts only after being alerted, which also raised concerns about inadequate moderation.
